font size only, never height (DECISIONS.md #818 keeps the registry's size): the registry's `text-sm` (14px) makes iOS Safari zoom the page when the select takes focus, which happens below 16px; `max-sm:text-base` is 16px on the phone and leaves the desktop at the registry's size (frontend.md §6, DECISIONS.md #821)

the registry's `transition-all` animates a property nobody asked for, `height` and `width` among them, and the button only changes color, border, shadow and the `active:translate-y-px` press: the transition lists them (_doc-lib/tailwindcss.md#transition-property, https://tailwindcss.com/docs/transition-property); `touch-manipulation` (`touch-action: manipulation`, tailwindcss.com/docs/touch-action, página oficial não conferida) drops the double-tap-zoom wait, so a tap answers at once on the phone (DECISIONS.md #821)
